about_the_game:
Enter the branch. Close the loop. Escape alive.

Unreality: Beyond Worlds is a handcrafted sci-fi exploration and extraction game with surreal horror elements. Step into unstable pocket dimensions known as branches to scavenge, investigate, and survive. Your mission? Close each branch before it mutates beyond your control.

This is Earth but something else is bleeding through. A twisted dimension has begun to leak into our reality, carving out unstable pockets of warped space known as branches. These zones defy logic: broken physics, melted time, impossible architecture, and echoes of things that never should exist.

Left unchecked, the bleed mutates. It spreads. It consumes.

Whole towns vanish overnight. People, places gone without a trace, absorbed into the unreality... SomniumCorp has developed the technology to enter these branches and shut them down before they devour everything.

You are one of their agents. Step in, close the loop, and get out before the branch swallows you too.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Close the rifts, survive the horrors beyond reality, and escape before the branch collapses. Unreality: Beyond Worlds is a multiplayer co-op survival horror where every contract is a fight against the unknown.
